_comment: API3 (spec-v2/14-api-and-packaging.md): runtime function/class exports still in @input/pen-types. Remove an entry in the same PR that relocates it.

entries.name: generateId
entries.reason: P.3: generateId stays; HOST4 requires a single ID helper and crdt-yjs still imports it from types

entries.name: formatUuidV4
entries.reason: P.3: private formatter for generateId; counted so unexported helpers cannot hide from the leftover total

entries.name: mapOffsetThroughSplices
entries.reason: P.3: required public by spec-v3 OB3, which supersedes API3 for this symbol. It replaces the deleted ChangeSummary.mapOffset/mapPoint/mapRange/compose algebra, so pen-types is where the derived tier already looks. Relocating it to core would put a runtime dependency on the same serialization packages the Wave 3 allowlist was written to spare. Added 2026-08-24 with the Wave 3 closure that deleted the algebra
